'''Organa''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] before he was succeeded by his son, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]].<ref name="DFR" /> He was also the father of [[Rouge Organa|Rouge]], [[Tia Organa|Tia]] and [[Celly Organa/Legends|Celly Organa]].<ref name="Family">The novel ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' established that [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] [[Parent/Legends|father]] was a [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]]. Since Bail and his sisters &mdash;who were first mentioned in [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]&mdash;share their surname, this article assumes that they had the same father.</ref>

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> the high houses of Alderaan came into conflict over the line of ascent to Viceroy. Known as the [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]], it strained the relations between the [[House of Antilles]] and the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] in particular.<ref name="DB-Scrambas, Pello">{{DB|character|pelloscambras|Scrambas, Pello}}</ref> A mediation delegation sent by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] maintained that the Organas had the proper claim to the seat, and this member of the family became the new Viceroy.<ref name="DFR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first name of the character has not been revealed. He was likely married to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Mazicia Organa]], although no official source has yet addressed this.
